text:
Tom (Sales): quick handoff for AuroraEdge (POC AE-210). Signed up for 6-week trial. Needs: private deployment in us-east, SAML SSO, customer KMS, embeddings import (~400k vectors), peak ~5 rps. Procurement asked for SOC2 summary + data deletion SLA. CC @Lina (CS)
Lina (CS): got it. I'll own onboarding and be main CS contact. Proposed flow: 1) sandbox + API keys 2) SSO metadata exchange 3) embeddings dry-run 4) tech kickoff 5) weekly health + feedback form.
Diego (Support): opening onboarding ticket and preflight. Quick Q: VPC peering or IP allowlist? Need to know for network sizing.
docs-bot: Ticket created: ONB-6102 · assignee: support-onboarding · link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-6102
Anya (Eng): hi — what's vector dim and preferred embeddings model? If they want redwood-embed-large with 1536 dim, migration tool needed. Estimate: migration + validation ~3d (1 eng), private build ~2d. Also confirm if they expect incremental sync.
Tom (Sales): spec here: https://drive.redwood/auroraedge/poc-spec.pdf. Vector dim = 1536, incremental sync required. They prefer redwood-embed-large. KMS required. POC kickoff target: next Thu morning. SOC2 summary needed now.
Lina (CS): action items recap:
- Tom: share final PM contact + SSO metadata by EOD
- Diego: create ONB-6102 preflight with VPC vs allowlist decision, due Wed
- Anya: post migration + private build estimate in ticket by Wed
- Lina: schedule kickoff Thu 10am ET, prepare enablement doc + feedback form
Also: renewal-risk note — they are evaluating two vendors; flag medium risk if procurement extends past 6 weeks.
Diego (Support): will ping networking, attach checklist to ONB-6102, and set day-30 reminder.
Anya (Eng): will post estimates + QA checklist in ONB-6102. If KMS integration, add +1d. Need sample vectors for smoke tests.
Tom (Sales): sharing PM info and SSO metadata now.
docs-bot: Reminder: onboarding kickoff scheduled Thu 10:00 ET — calendar invite sent.
Lina (CS): thanks everyone — i'll post meeting agenda (SSO, migration plan, tests, rollback criteria, feedback capture) and link to feedback form after kickoff. Please comment on ONB-6102 with blockers.
